transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom call 1 (2026-09-11, ~56 min, "SMB Team 360 Law Firm Analysis") — https://fathom.video/calls/817947088

Attendees: Dan Bryant (SMB Team, seller), Justin Fowles (Owner/Attorney, Criminal Defense, Conroe TX).
Trigger: Justin opted for a 1:1 discovery instead of a full-day event.

Law Firm Profile:
- Current revenue: ~$500K gross run rate in 2026.
- Desired revenue: $700K-$1M near term; open to $1.5M-$2M+ longer term.
- Average case value: DWI example at $4,000.
- Monthly client volume: 7-8 new clients/month.

Current Challenges:
- Local SEO: only ~4% share of Google Maps 3-pack local voice vs. competitors Doug (~100%) and Brian Foley (~87%).
- Review gap: ~120 reviews vs. competitors at 200-300+.
- Website issues: contact form buried, weak CTA, unoptimized cover photo, possible page cannibalization.
- CRM/intake friction: locked out of Lawmatics due to a 2FA issue, unused ~2.5 months.
- No PPC/LSA active despite interest; overreliant on organic SEO/press releases.
- Torn between scaling criminal defense vs. building a transactional (estate/probate) practice line.

Team & Operations:
- Justin (owner/attorney); Iris (FT intake/client comms, ~20 years sales experience, closes deals, handles calls 24/7); a PT assistant (evidence downloads/calendar, remote, minimal hours).
- Payments via Clio Payments; some clients pay in full pre-meeting.
- Recently adopted Clio Manage for case management (prior storage on Google Drive).

Dominant Buying Motive:
- Build a self-managing firm; wants 10-20 hour workweeks, largely remote, to travel with young children (daughter ~1.5, son ~4).
- Interested in a transactional/estate-planning line as a lower-labor, saleable asset for lifestyle goals.

Next Steps (as of this call): Solution call requested for the following week (~90 min); Dan to send resources; Justin to evaluate VXT/Clio Grow/CallRail integrations; SMB Team to audit website + local SEO + PPC/LSA plan.

---

SOURCE: Fathom call 2 (2026-09-15, ~159 min, "Proposal Review Meeting") — https://fathom.video/calls/821797307

Attendees: Dan Bryant (SMB Team, seller), Justin Fowles (Owner/Attorney), Iris (Office Assistant/Integrator — de facto intake/sales/ops).
Trigger: Proposal review to scale the firm; prior positive ROI from LegalMatch; interest in replacing the current web/SEO vendor and adding Google LSA/PPC + coaching.
Notable live event: Justin retained a walk-in client during the call (PCS-THC felony, $4,000 flat fee with a payment plan: $1K today, $2K on 9/29, $1K on 10/6).

Law Firm Profile (updated):
- Current revenue: ~$500K-$600K run rate in 2026 (Justin expects "mid-6" this year).
- Desired revenue: $1M gross in ~3 years; longer-term path to $3M-$5M to net $1M profit.
- Average case value: $4,000-$6,500 discussed; aligned on $5,000 as a working average.
- Monthly client volume: currently ~8-10 retained/month; capacity goal of ~18/month (needs ~40 additional qualified calls/month at ~25% close rate).
- Consultation close rate: ~30-32% per Lawmatics; Dan suggested planning conservatively at 20-25%.

Current Challenges:
- LegalMatch lead quality mix: heavy traffic-ticket leads the firm doesn't take, requiring heavy manual filtering by Iris. LegalMatch ROI: ~$90K-$100K collected over ~10 months on ~$775/month spend.
- Website/SEO foundational errors: homepage not optimized for "Conroe Criminal Defense," conflicting pages, broken images.
- Capacity strain risk if call volume increases; no overflow answering service for after-hours/peak.
- No documented hiring process/KPIs for attorneys; no clear path to a self-managing team.
- Vacation test: ~1 week zero-contact before issues begin.
- No defined profit target distinct from revenue target.

Marketing Assessment:
- ~114 Google reviews currently; plan to accelerate to 200+ to lift Maps ranking, pricing power, and ad performance.
- Existing SEO/website vendor: Justin "happy" but Iris believes significant improvements are needed.

Next Steps: Follow-up "formal plan/pricing review" call scheduled for 2026-09-16 at 9:30 AM CT. Plan to replace/upgrade web/SEO management, launch Google LSA first (then possibly PPC), private Google Reviews training, consider short FAQ/Why-Us videos, evaluate an overflow answering service.

Additional Notes:
- Practice focus: criminal defense — DWI, drug (often felony), domestic violence; no traffic tickets; occasional Class C misdemeanors.
- Pricing: DWIs now rarely under $5K; drugs often $4K-$5K+; DV similar; ~$5K average working estimate.
- Geography: Conroe, TX (Montgomery County), affluent/fast-growing; competitors: Doug Atkinson, Brian Foley, Zavala/Santos.
- Tech stack: Lawmatics (CRM/intake), Clio + Clio AI (case management/billing).
- Dominant buying motive (reaffirmed): self-managing firm within ~3 years, working <=20 hrs/week, homeschooling flexibility, avoiding a "die at the desk" trajectory.

NOTE FOR RESEARCH: The seller (Dan Bryant) has separately indicated in Slack that he wants to build this proposal from both calls above, and referenced Full Service Marketing — Starter ($4,997/mo) and Elite Coach Plus ($3,200/mo) as the packages under discussion — treat this as context, not as a substitute for applying the standard deterministic package-selection rules to the research below.
